facts.text: The resort is in the town of Surfers Paradise on the Gold Coast.
facts.excerpt: Unwind at a 5-star resort on the Gold Coast in the town of Surfers Paradise.

facts.text: The resort has a private marina behind the pool area, on the Gold Coast's Nerang River.
facts.excerpt: Our private marina is located behind the pool area of our hotel near the beach on the Gold Coast's Nerang River.

facts.text: The saltwater lagoon has white sandy beaches, a swim-up grotto and waterfalls, and is streaming with tropical fish.
facts.excerpt: Pools of varying depths and activations including the white sandy beaches, swim-up grotto, and waterfalls unique to the saltwater lagoon, streaming with tropical fish

facts.text: The saltwater lagoon is streaming with over 200 tropical fish.
facts.excerpt: the white sandy beaches unique to the saltwater lagoon, streaming with over 200 tropical fish

facts.text: There is also a freshwater pool with a children's slide.
facts.excerpt: the fresh water pool with children’s slide

facts.text: The water sports kiosk has snorkels, flippers and motorized aquatic scooters for hire.
facts.excerpt: The water sports kiosk provides for-hire snorkels, flippers, and motorized aquatic scooters.

facts.text: Guests can join the daily feeding of the lagoon's tropical fish, followed by a JW Garden tour.
facts.excerpt: Join us as we feed our tropical fish daily, followed by our JW Garden Tour.

facts.text: The JW Garden is an on-property farm-to-table program growing seasonal herbs, edible flowers, fruits and vegetables for the resort's menus.
facts.excerpt: The JW Garden is our on-property farm-to-table program creating a sustainable way for our chefs to elevate the resort menus with seasonal herbs, edible flowers, fruits, and vegetables.

facts.text: The resort was originally built in 1993.
facts.excerpt: Originally built in 1993, JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa has become an iconic Gold Coast, Australia, resort

facts.text: Australian design studio DBI, the property's original architects and interior designers, reimagined the resort drawing inspiration from the Gold Coast Hinterland.
facts.excerpt: Award winning Australian design studio, DBI, the original architects and interior designers behind the existing property, were engaged to reimagine the iconic resort and to elevate the property to JW Marriott’s high standards of modern luxury, drawing inspiration from the Gold Coast Hinterland.

facts.text: Guestrooms have views of the Pacific Ocean or the Gold Coast Hinterland.
facts.excerpt: Located on the northern shores of Surfers Paradise, enjoy JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa guestrooms with views of the Pacific Ocean or the Gold Coast Hinterlands.

facts.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: plus an additional 23 hotel suites with floor to ceiling windows, bathing each room in ample natural light

facts.text: The Executive Suites are on the resort's top floors, with panoramic views of the Gold Coast Hinterland and Pacific Ocean and a separate lounge room.
facts.excerpt: featuring panoramic views of The Gold Coast Hinterland and Pacific Ocean. Located on the resort's top floors, the 93 square meter Executive Suites, boast a plush king bed, a separate lounge room

facts.text: Ocean King rooms have a private balcony with ocean views and views of the resort's Lagoon Pool.
facts.excerpt: From your private balcony, sweeping ocean outlooks and views of the resort’s signature Lagoon Pool capture the coastal beauty of the destination.

facts.text: Spa by JW treatments focus on four benefits: Calm, Indulge, Invigorate and Renew.
facts.excerpt: focused on delivering four distinctive benefits — Calm, Indulge, Invigorate, and Renew

facts.text: Spa by JW has a steam room and separate men's and women's lounges.
facts.excerpt:
Separate Men & Women's Lounges

Steam Room

facts.text: Family by JW offers activities such as the Mini Misono sushi-making class, family yoga and herb planting in the JW Garden.
facts.excerpt: Join the Mini Misono sushi-making class, family yoga, or participate in herb planting in the JW Garden

facts.text: Citrique was awarded an Australian Good Food Guide Chef Hat for 2023 to 2026.
facts.excerpt: awarded an Australian Good Food Guide Chef Hat 2023 - 2026

facts.text: Misono is a teppanyaki-style restaurant with a whiskey bar with an outdoor terrace, an Izakaya and a live sushi table.
facts.excerpt: Misono is our teppanyaki-style restaurant on the Gold Coast. An invitation to connect and enjoy, discover a refined whiskey bar with an outdoor terrace, an intimate Izakaya and our live sushi table.

facts.text: Chapter & Verse serves high tea, handcrafted cocktails and all-day dining.
facts.excerpt: Experience luxury high tea at Chapter & Verse. Our unique Gold Coast hotel restaurant and bar offers handcrafted cocktails, all-day dining

facts.text: Odyssey Jet Ski Tours runs guided jet ski tours from the resort's private marina through the Broadwater.
facts.excerpt: Explore the Gold Coast waterways with a guided tour by Odyssey Jet Ski Tours. Located on the resort's private marina

facts.text: Guests receive a signature welcome ritual with lavender iced tea on arrival.
facts.excerpt: Guests receive the JW signature welcome ritual with lavender iced tea beverage on arrival.

facts.text: The resort has poolside cabanas available for half-day or full-day hire.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a half-day or full-day cabana retreat with food and beverage packages optional.

facts.text: The resort has an outdoor multipurpose sports court.
facts.excerpt: plus an outdoor multipurpose sports court

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa Fitness Center, located on level 3. Open 24 hours a day.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa.

facts.text: The closest airport is Gold Coast Airport.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa is Gold Coast Airport (OOL).

facts.text: The resort was awarded Australia's Best Hotel Pool in 2021 and 2024.
facts.excerpt: Awarded Australia’s Best Hotel Pool 2021 and 2024

facts.text: Aqua Sculpt floating Pilates is offered at the resort.
facts.excerpt: Explore dining, Spa by JW, Family by JW, upcoming events and Aqua Sculpt Floating Pilates
